description: This Java class implements a ResultSetExtractor to process SQL query results into a list of Grouping objects, organizing entities and actions based on database result set data.

classes.name: EventResultSetExtractor
classes.description: A class that extracts and organizes data from a SQL ResultSet into a list of Grouping objects, grouping entities and their actions.

methods.name: extractData
methods.description: Processes the ResultSet to build a list of Grouping objects, each containing entities and their sorted actions.
